business_summary: Energy International Investments Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the oil and liquefied chemical terminal leasing businesses in the People's Republic of China. The company involved in the storage and logistics facilities business, as well as provides as credit assessment, fund matching, and technical services for financial institutions. It also engages in the trading activity of electronic products; and the provision of agency services for trading of oil and liquefied chemical products. The company was formerly known as Xian Yuen Titanium Resources Holdings Limited and changed its name to Energy International Investments Holdings Limited in September 2010. Energy International Investments Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Energy International Investments Holdings Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 석유 및 액화화학 터미널 임대 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 보관 및 물류시설 사업을 영위하는 회사로, 금융기관에 신용평가, 펀드매칭, 기술서비스 등을 제공하고 있습니다. 또한 전자제품의 거래 활동에도 참여합니다. 석유 및 액화화학제품의 거래를 위한 대행 서비스 제공. 이 회사는 이전에 Xian Yuen Titanium Resources Holdings Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2010년 9월에 Energy International Investments Holdings Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Energy International Investments Holdings Limited는 2000년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
